Replays tested on Maki

No replay has run on Maki. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Maki.

What the Maki setup page says about coverage

Wrap gates the commands you route through it. Maki invocations made any other way (an interactive session, an unwrapped script) never touch KYA. Coverage is exactly the set of invocations you wrap, no more.

Source: the Maki recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
